name: Shy-Rotam
summary: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook asks you to defeat Shy-Rotam, matriarch of the frostsabers. Her defeat would earn respect from your fellow race.

sections.title: At Frostsaber Rock
sections.body: Sacred meat from the frostsabers is meant for the stone of Shy-Rotam in northern Winterspring. Place it there, and the matriarch will come in anger. Storm Shadowhoof asks you to face her, with your standing among your fellow race at stake.

faq.answer: Shy-Rotam is the matriarch of the great cats gathered around Frostsaber Rock in northern Winterspring.

faq.q: Who asks me to face Shy-Rotam?
faq.answer: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook asks you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
The stone of Shy-Rotam is where you place sacred meat from the frostsabers to summon her.

faq.q: Why does Storm want Shy-Rotam defeated?
faq.answer: Defeating the frostsaber matriarch would earn you respect from your fellow race.
